service.description: Sales' setup readiness, answering the framework's readiness contract (moqui.server.ReadinessProvider sales.readiness) with no adapter: called with providerKey and an organizationPartyId (or none, for each organization of the caller's scope that uses Sales: a pipeline, a team, a lead source offered or an opportunity of its own), returns checks of checkKey, title, state (ready, warning, failed or unavailable), reasonCode, message, the organization as subject and scope, and for a check that is not ready its owner's place as a route key (fixRoute, with fixId where it names a record): a default pipeline (salesStages), a pipeline in effect without stages (salesStages, the pipeline), a team with a member (salesTeams) and a lead source offered (salesLeadSources); P9 the Sales defaults and the commercial revision (salesDefaults), P13 the public quote pages, and P19 Sales' scheduled jobs (none paused or failing on its last run), its mail templates (the organization's or Mantle's quote, reminder and confirmation templates with a from address and a mail server) and its approval rules (salesApprovalPolicies: the approval setting on with no rule). One check that fails is unavailable by name and the others go on. Changes nothing. Refuses a caller without SALES_CONFIGURE (PERMISSION_DENIED) and an organization outside their scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

The accounts of the caller's sales scope (AccountList): parties with a Customer or Prospect role that are not internal, disabled or someone else's personal contacts, owned by the organization named (which must be in the scope) or by any organization of the scope, and the shared ones (owner _NA_); by name or id (text, ignoring case), role, kind, account manager (mine Y: the caller's), parent account. Each row: its name, kind, role, owner, account managers, first contact and contact count, and, for a holder of SALES_TEAM_VIEW, its open orders with the scope's organizations (null otherwise). Paged in the query (accountList and its page fields; pageNoLimit, up to 1000, for an export).

The contacts of the accounts of the caller's sales scope (Contacts): current PrtContact relationships from a person to an account the caller may see, the person also one they may see, of one account (accountPartyId, refused when outside the scope: RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or organization (organizationPartyId) when named; by name or account name (text). Each row: the relationship, the person, the account, the title, email, phone and the date from. Paged in the query.

Customer360's Sales summary of an account of the caller's sales scope (crosscut §3.2 Sales row): its name, kind, role, owner (or shared), email and phone, account managers, parent and child accounts of the scope, current contacts (each with title, email and phone), what the caller may do (canEdit: SALES_ACCOUNT_EDIT; canManage: a manager's change of the account manager; canMerge: a Sales manager or administrator for an account of their organization), and by their rights its orders with the scope's organizations (organizationPartyId narrows them; ordersRead for a holder of SALES_TEAM_VIEW, until Sales' order scope) and its invoices from them (financeRead: ACCOUNTING_VIEW or RECEIVABLE_VIEW), each withheld otherwise. An account the caller may not see answers customerFound false, like a missing one.

The Sales documents each party carries with the organizations of the caller's sales scope, for MergeAccounts' Compare (design §4): its opportunities (as the account or a party of one), orders and agreements. A party the caller may not see gives no row. Refuses a caller without SALES_TEAM_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

My accounts, a projected CardDAV address book (SalesIntakeData.xml's ContactProjection SalesMyAccounts; mantle.party.ContactDavServices): admitted is whether the user reads Sales (SALES_VIEW, SALES_TEAM_VIEW or SALES_REPORT_VIEW); without checkOnly, the current contacts of the accounts the user may see that they manage or that are the account of a deal assigned now to them or a team of theirs, each a person they may see, computed per request (at most 2000). Another team's accounts are absent. Read only: a device's write is refused by the projection.

Sales Home's work (design §3 Home SalesWork and AssignedWork): counters, each the count of the scoped list it opens with that list's own filters (find#Opportunities: the leads to work, the user's own open opportunities and those of them past their expected close), with its listPath and parameters; a counter that fails is unavailable, never zero, and the others go on; P8: the requests for quote awaiting a response (find#QuoteRequests state awaiting); the counters of records not built yet (quotes to send and expiring, blocked orders) are notConfigured. assignedWork: the user's own open leads and opportunities, the soonest to close first, each with its next activity (at most ten; assignedCount all of them). In the organization named (in the scope, ORGANIZATION_DENIED otherwise) or every one of the scope. Refuses a caller who reads nothing of Sales (PERMISSION_DENIED).

The report engine's row filter of the pipeline dataset (report/mantle-sales-pipeline.json; the ReportScopePolicy MantleSalesScope, data/SalesWorkspaceData.xml): Sales' scope, not the organization alone (impl-sales F66): the deals of the organizations of the signed-in viewer's sales scope and, without SALES_TEAM_VIEW, of those only the deals assigned now to the viewer or a team of theirs. Nothing for a viewer who reads nothing of Sales; a userId of another user is refused.

The report engine's row filter of the quote dataset (report/mantle-sales-quotes.json; the ReportScopePolicy MantleSalesQuoteScope, data/SalesWorkspaceData.xml; impl-sales P20): Sales' quote scope, as the quote lists read it: Sales quotes (never a template) not placed, of the organizations of the signed-in viewer's sales scope and, without SALES_TEAM_VIEW, of those only the quotes assigned to the viewer or a team of theirs. Nothing for a viewer who reads nothing of Sales; a userId of another user is refused.

Sales' lifecycle participant's lookup (design-admin §14; impl-sales P6, F54): what userId owns of Sales, for an offboarding preview: the open leads and opportunities they own now (resourceId deal:id), their open quotes (Open, Requested or Proposed and never placed; quote:orderId, P7) and the accounts they manage now (account:partyId), each named with its organization, never an amount, all transferable but a shared account. The caller's own, or another user's with SALES_OWNER_CHANGE (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise).

One deal, quote or account of fromUserId's handed to toUserId's person (the owned-resource contract): a deal's owner row ends now and the new owner's starts (its team kept), an open quote's owner row (undated) is replaced by the new owner's (its team and contact kept; P7), an account's manager relationship ends now and the new manager's starts. With SALES_OWNER_CHANGE (PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). Refuses a resource fromUserId does not own now (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a closed deal or a quote no longer open (RECORD_CLOSED), a new owner with no enabled account and person (OWNER_INVALID) and one who does not work for the record's organization (NOT_EMPLOYED).

The one scoped list of sales orders (design §6 OrderList, Home, Insights and the palette): orders whose first part sells (an internal vendor of the caller's scope, a customer that is not internal), the caller's and their teams' (the organization's every one for SALES_TEAM_VIEW; and for SALES_ORDER_APPROVE those awaiting approval or held), never a quote not yet placed, a quote template, a recurring base or an open cart (a direct draft is listed under draft). Saved lists: recent (any, the default), draft, awaiting (Placed: Awaiting approval), held, blocked (awaiting or held), toFulfill (approved, nothing shipped), partFulfilled (approved, some shipped), toInvoice (shipped, nothing billed), cancelled; filtered by organization, customer, opportunity, owner (mine Y: the caller), store and text (id, name or the customer's reference), paged in the query. Each row's customer (unnamed when the caller may not see the account), seller, kind, state, total, open holds and progress (shipped of ordered by line unit, billed of the total by currency; never summed across units), and on the awaiting list its pre-approval warnings. Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

Sales' report catalogue (design-sales §8 Reports SalesReportCatalogue; impl-sales P19), the catalogue service of Sales' entries in Insights' catalog (catalogueService, called with appRoot): the reports the caller may read, each with its entry id, report id, owner, title, description, path under the app root, parameters and whether it exports. Sales summary, Sales analysis, Pipeline analysis, Win/loss and Target attainment for a report reader (SALES_REPORT_VIEW), Forecast for every Sales reader. Refuses another app root (REPORTS_UNAVAILABLE: Accounting's mount of Sales analysis has its own entry under Accounting's catalogue, F59) and a caller who reads no Sales (PERMISSION_DENIED).
